notes.title: The End of the Sun has been officially verified on Steam Deck!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][h3]We've got some great news! [/h3][h3][b]The End of the Sun[/b] has been officially [b]verified on Steam Deck.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This means you can now enjoy the full game experience on the go![/p][p]We appreciate all your support and can't wait for you to explore our world wherever you are.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/b1037a376e02774bd87e834f383b30c1333f9a70.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Steam Deck verification is only granted for the [b]full version of the game[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Technical info:[/b][/p][p]When you first launch the game on your Steam Deck, it will automatically run with the graphic preset we've tested and optimised. However, if you want to experiment with higher or lower graphical settings for better quality or performance, you're free to do so.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Read  More on the forum below:[/b][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/912840/discussions/0/594013679434861510/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/912840/discussions/0/594013679434861510/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/459d30d318521492faf2b49ac04adbfa27a44d13.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Check out how The End of the Sun works on Steam Deck![/h3][previewyoutube="Kj3KItR2HmQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Happy gaming![/h3]

notes.title: The End of the Sun : Prologue & Trading Cards Available NOW!
notes.content: [h2]The End of the Sun: Prologue is Available NOW![/h2][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p] We're thrilled to announce that [b]The End of the Sun: Prologue[/b] is officially here and completely [b]FREE to play[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/f63295cac2f7995ba5877c5d3ab4ebb68e328a1c.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]What to Expect in the Prologue[/h3][p][/p][p]The prologue will feature the [b]first mission of the game[/b] and one[b] mission[/b] to showcase the time-travelling mechanics. [/p][p]We created this prologue to give you a taste of the full game and help you decide if The End of the Sun is for you![/p][p][/p][p][b]Step into a world inspired by Slavic myths and legends.[/b][/p][p]As an [b]ashter[/b], a Slavic sorcerer blessed with an incredible gift, you arrive at a mysterious, abandoned village. You find an [b]unusual map[/b] there and begin to explore the area. Initially, you encounter no one, seeing only dimly flickering bonfires. Y[b]our power, however, allows you to connect with the fire[/b], to see visions, and to shape the seemingly ordinary fates of the villagers. Each rekindled bonfire presents a unique challenge steeped in Slavic legends.[/p][p]Dive in and experience the beginning of this unique adventure. We can't wait for you to explore the secrets within![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/1a5f3d17584243d81282fae9cd3b3b8ede7cf215.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/582d2cb48bc11a2fca1a46ebc92bb20686f8a16e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/fcd1eeed336cce4833046b0fb0997242735809b6.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h2]Wishlist, PLAY, and Write a REVIEW![/h2][p][/p][p]We'd be incredibly grateful if you could [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]! It might seem like just one click, but it significantly boosts our visibility on Steam and helps us out a lot![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820900/The_End_of_the_Sun_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you like the game, don't forget to [b]write a REVIEW on the The End of the Sun: Prologue page[/b]! [/p][p]Visit the prologue store page and write even a few words, your thoughts, and your feedback mean a lot for our small team! :) [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/af5136cacc7709dcdd7fd9bdde0f2eefc9f36fdf.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Community Items - Trading Cards & Points Shop Items[/h2][p]Amazing news! For all you collectors out there, [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] are now available for The End of the Sun! [/p][p]You can also get:[/p][list][*][p]badges[/p][/*][*][p]profile backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]emoticons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Start collecting them today![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/d7da2a31d56c8747b3a28c99fd056a6fc2eec0a9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Photo Mode is Coming![/h2][p][/p][p]Great News! We've heard your requests, and we're thrilled to announce that a [b]Photo Mode[/b] will be available in the full version of the game![/p][p]Get ready to capture your favorite in-game moments like never before. [/p][p][/p][p]Photo Mode is coming [b]this Sunday! (July 20th)[/b] Stay tuned![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/d20fec41f1392aedcd0010b647e94c2900ea34a0.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]TRUE INDIE GAME![/h3][p]As you know, The End of the Sun is a true indie game. Created for over 8 years with passion, mainly by a two-person team.[/p][p]We’d be thrilled if you could spread the word about our game on your social media, gaming forums you frequent, Discord groups, or even your own gaming channels. Whether it's a post, a share, or even just telling a friend, every bit of support means the world to us and helps get the word out about The End of The Sun.[/p][p][/p][h3]I have the full version of the game. Can I help?[/h3][p][/p][p]Yes! [/p][list][*][p]Even if you have already played the full version, please [b]wishlist Prologue and write a review,[/b] it will help us a lot to stay in indie development and make next games. [/p][/*][*][p]Share this news, whatever you want![/p][/*][/list][p]Thank You![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]We can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback about the prologue![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/9d099e56e567fa21501a075c8610a9c023f7609b.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Happy Summer Solstice!
notes.content: [p]Happy Summer Solstice! [img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t6d/1/16/2600.png"][/img][/p][p]Today it's the [b]shortest night of the year[/b], in Slavic tradition known as Kupala Night (Noc Kupały). This is one of the most significant and boisterously celebrated holidays.[/p][p]And guess what? [b]You can experience the magic of this very holiday within our game!![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/1cdc59765cb9c530af75bb707b26ad0e65644b55.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Immerse yourself in incredible customs like [b]wreath floating[/b], [b]jumping over bonfires[/b], the mystical [b]search for the fern flower[/b], and various [b]fortune-telling rituals[/b]. notes.title: Happy Spring Holidays!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Players![/b]

On the occasion of the upcoming Easter Holiday, we wholeheartedly wish you all the best! May this joyful time bring you much warmth, optimism, and prosperity!

The spring holidays have their roots in the ancient Slavic festival - Revival Festival (Jare Gody). These ancient celebrations of nature awakening to life, full of joy and hope for a bountiful harvest, gave rise to the holidays we know today. We hope you experience the atmosphere of Revival Festival (Jare Gody) by participating in events and observing traditions in the open, mysterious world of The End of The Sun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/33e678083f34d8c2c199bd67be8b209932574839.jpg[/img]

One of the characteristic customs of the Revival Festival, which you may have observed in the game, is the creation of "Hand-scratched eggs." These beautifully decorated eggs, created by scratching patterns on a dyed shell, symbolise new life and the spring awakening. This is just one of the many fascinating elements of Slavic culture that we strive to bring closer to you during the game.

Hand-scratched eggs (In Polish "Skrobanki") are humorously described in the game by the Asther (the character you embody in The End of the Sun):
[quote]Beautifully decorated eggs. Boiled in onion peels to give them a dark brown colour. They say that hand-scratched eggs gifted during the Revival festival will ensure a household's fertility... unless gifted by a malicious neighbour, in which case they'll only bring the stench of rot to the cottage.[/quote]

[h2]What's coming?[/h2]

A new game update with an additional language is coming soon! What language? You'll find out soon :)

In addition, soon, two full vocal songs from The End of the Sun will appear on Spotify and YouTube. You can already follow the channels where they will be available and receive notifications:

[url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/3yu7y4epguJWbecoPN1824]Spotify - Kinga Rąpała[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@TheEndOfTheSun]Youtube - The End of the Sun Game[/url]

You can purchase full, beautiful,l and unique Soundtrack on Steam at any time:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3225340/The_End_of_the_Sun_Soundtrack/?l=polish

We wish you these holidays to be full of joy, peace, and wonderful fun, both in the real world and in our virtual fairy tale. May this springtime recharge you with positive energy for more adventures!

Happy Spring Holidays!

[b]Hello folks,[/b]
Today it's time to explain to new players some elements of The End of the Sun :)

[h1]Step into a Slavic Fairy Tale[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/866b3e4d09eb502f7e06d8a704f1ea883157ad0c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Experience the Magic[/h3]

Get ready to embark on a journey through a world that blends myth, folklore, and the supernatural. The End of The Sun invites you into a [b]Slavic fairy tale[/b] where reality and legend intertwine. Inspired by rich [b]Slavic mythology[/b], the game brings to life a mysterious village where timeless stories, ancient rituals, and haunting myths await.

[h3]Explore a World[/h3]

In The End of The Sun, players take on the role of an [b]Ashter[/b]—a wise sorcerer—gifted with the power to travel through time. Each season brings new insights, secrets, and stories, unfolding in a beautifully crafted [b]open world[/b]. Move through time uncovering mysteries hidden across the seasons. Actions in the past will ripple forward, reshaping the future and deepening your connection to the characters and their fates.

Amidst exploration and adventure, you’ll discover the threads of a[b] touching love story[/b], woven into the fabric of this mythical village. From festivals celebrating life and nature to encounters with spirits and folklore, the narrative immerses you in the world of the ancients, where [b]love and fate[/b] are often intertwined.

notes.title: Share your feedback with us!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

The first wave of emotions has settled! We’ve finally made it to the long-awaited release![b] From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for all the warm and positive feedback on the game.[/b] The way you’re experiencing it is a dream come true for us as developers—after nearly eight years of dedication, seeing your reactions makes it all worthwhile.

We’re especially happy that you’re not encountering major bugs—polishing the game was a big priority for us. We also love reading your thoughts on the story! Feel free to reach out here on the Steam forum or via email—we read every message with great joy.

Moreover, we wanted to let you know that [b]Steam Cloud Save, which many of you have requested, is now available![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/882ae724c625aebd8c46db63c66df2c819191d4b.jpg[/img]

But our work isn’t done yet! Some of you have suggested additional settings and small tweaks. We’re open to them, and after a short break—because, you know, we need to catch our breath after these eight years—we’ll be back to work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/fa0556c5035dc3bfcc68ae955ef1b2fe0258942f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Share your feedback with us! [/h3]

Now, we have one small request:[b] if you’re enjoying the game, please leave a review on Steam.[/b] 

It doesn't have to be long sophisticated text, [b]even a few words are enough[/b] :)  You could do it on our steam store.


[b]So, if you can share The End of The Sun with your friends, post about it, or even let your favorite streamers know about the game—it would help us more than you can imagine.[/b]

Everything we’ve achieved so far has been thanks to your incredible support. Without you, none of this would have been possible. And now, you get to explore the magical world of Slavic myths, uncover its moving story, eat mushrooms, and talk to mice.

Oh, and… has anyone found the radio yet? Haha. Our game is filled with secrets and surprises you probably wouldn’t expect!

Let us know in the comments what you love most about The End of The Sun so far—and keep spreading the word! Thank you!

[b]- Support Indie Developers:[/b] By purchasing the soundtrack, you’re directly contributing to the development of our small, passionate team.

Drawing inspiration from Slavic folk music, the soundtrack captures the game’s mystical ambiance. From haunting chants to beautiful ballads, each track mirrors the mystery, magic, and beauty of The End of The Sun. Whether you’re exploring the changing seasons or uncovering secrets, these tracks enhance the connection to the game’s narrative.

notes.title: Gameplay Explained - Developer Update
notes.content:
Hello friends,
The countdown to the release of The End of The Sun has begun! Today, we want to give you an inside look at the gameplay in our game, highlighting its key features and what you should pay attention to as you play.

In this update, you'll also find tips on additional activities, Steam achievements, and... Easter eggs! Plus, a small update on system requirements to ensure you're ready to dive in.

Enjoy the read, and remember: you'll immerse yourself in the world of Slavic myths and legends in The End of The Sun starting [b]January 29, 2025![/b]

[h3]What Will You Do in The End of The Sun?[/h3]

While The End of The Sun focuses heavily on exploring an open, immersive world, don’t worry—there’s plenty to do! The game invites you to wander through breathtaking locations steeped in Slavic atmosphere, but exploration is just the beginning. 
Get ready to solve puzzles, uncover mysteries, and delve into a rich narrative full of surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/32748c47d55f233d0df71552965ee1ccaed6db31.png[/img]

[h3]Follow the Trails of Time[/h3]

As you explore the world of The End of The Sun, you’ll encounter mysterious campfires. These fires are directly linked to pivotal events in the lives of the characters and specific seasons of the year. 
Light a bonfire during the correct season, and smoke will rise to guide you to key locations.

 This will lead you to discover "Traces of Time"—fragments of events tied to a particular place. When a vision rewinds its timeline, it indicates that the story is incomplete. Your task? Find specific objects related to the Trace of Time and restore the proper sequence of events, stabilizing the path of fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/db20af0cdd6182788b886009129f88449c025618.gif[/img]

[h3]Non-Linear Storytelling[/h3]

Each campfire may connect to others, creating an intricate web of events. However, the order in which you tackle missions and uncover the story is entirely up to you. This freedom allows you to experience the narrative at your own pace, making your journey uniquely personal.

[h3]Logic Meets Lore[/h3]

Along the way, you’ll encounter logical puzzles deeply intertwined with the fates of the characters. Solving these not only progresses the story but also gives you the power to influence the unfolding events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/79d671961693bd8ac05fe81fabf1f2b762450269.jpg[/img]

[h3]Learn and Discover[/h3]

Dive deeper into the world to uncover special items marked as "Knowledge." These objects come with stories about their historical and cultural significance, offering a fascinating glimpse into the lives and tools of our Slavic ancestors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/622cf40f86dc6c50055ebb86b6154927bf663615.jpg[/img]

[h3]Achievements and Secrets Await[/h3]

For achievement hunters, we’ve hidden numerous Steam Achievements throughout the game. Whether you’re progressing the main storyline or just exploring for fun, you’ll have plenty of challenges to tackle.

And for the most observant adventurers, we’ve scattered a few subtle Easter Eggs in the game. Keep your eyes peeled—you never know what you might find!

With its unique blend of exploration, puzzle-solving, and storytelling, The End of The Sun offers a one-of-a-kind gaming experience. Will you uncover the secrets hidden in the trails of time?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/8a0c4cd5e8d496c0dd7d4c338a71b799b05ccdd9.jpg[/img]



[h3]Important Notice:[/h3]
We want to let you know that we have updated the system requirements for the game. You can find them in the corresponding section on our Steam Page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/8af83f50f8c7551422982e284926ebd433c722dc.jpg[/img]


[h3]Wishlist now and join us on this Slavic-inspired journey through the seasons of life![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/912840/The_End_of_the_Sun/

Check out our new trailer!
[previewyoutube=Zqf_P-xnYYw;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]Thanks for your ongoing support![/b]
The End of the Sun Team
